But meaning is rarer. We design journeys through an editorial lens, shaped by place, the lives that move through it, and the quiet evolution of the traveler. These are experiences that endure. They linger because they reshape the way you see. Because they meet you at the right moment. ㅤ Welcome to the inner circle. Frequently Asked Questions 01 Why use Spots instead of planning it myself? Most trips today begin the same way: dozens of tabs, conflicting recommendations, and hours spent trying to figure out what is actually worth your time. Spots exists to make that process more thoughtful, efficient, and aligned with what you value.
